article.story: RIVERSIDE, Calif. -- — Andrew Henderson's 19 points helped UC Riverside defeat Long Beach State 71-61 on Thursday night. Henderson also contributed five rebounds for the Highlanders (8-14, 3-7 Big West Conference). Ben Waller added 13 points while shooting 4 of 7 from the field and 5 for 9 from the line. BJ Kolly shot 5 of 7 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. Isaiah Lewis finished with 13 points for the Beach (8-14, 4-6). Shaquil Bender added 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
